title: Malicious code in @bellaxchan/wabails (npm)
description: The npm package @bellaxchan/wabails contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised machine. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by its installation.
